title: PutAnythingYouWantOnYourHead
description: Wear any item in the helmet slot for a silly or stylish look!
body:
中文描述 Describe in Chinese
# 万物皆可戴头上

**想过把泥土块当帽子戴吗？现在你可以了！**

---

## 📖 这个模组有什么用？

这个模组只移除了原版**头盔槽**的装备限制。

安装本模组后，你可以把游戏中的**任何物品**戴在头上，包括：

- 🧱 **方块** - 泥土、石头、钻石块、楼梯……
- ⚔️ **工具和武器** - 剑、镐、弓……
- 🍎 **食物** - 面包、牛排、金苹果……
- 🔴 **红石元件** - 活塞、中继器、比较器……
- 🎨 **其他模组的物品**

物品会正常显示在你角色的头上，就像普通的头盔一样。

> **重要**：原版的其他盔甲槽（胸甲、护腿、靴子）**完全不受影响**，功能照常。

---

## 🎯 为什么下载？

- **有趣又创意** - 把任何东西戴在头上，搞怪又时尚
- **角色扮演** - 扮演泥土怪或者行走的钻石块！
- **轻量级** - 只有一个简单功能，不影响性能
- **多人游戏支持** - 客户端和服务端都需要安装
- **开源** - MIT 协议，可自由用于整合包

---

## ⚠️ 注意事项

### 兼容性
- **Minecraft 版本**：1.20.1
- **模组加载器**：Forge 47.2.0 或更高版本

### 重要说明
- 戴在头上的物品**不会提供护甲值**，除非物品本身有护甲属性（比如钻石头盔依然保护你，但泥土不会）
- 其他盔甲槽（胸甲、护腿、靴子）**功能完整**——本模组只修改头盔槽
- 多人游戏时，**客户端和服务端都需要**安装本模组

### 安装方法
1. 下载 `.jar` 文件
2. 放入 `.minecraft/mods` 文件夹（客户端）或服务端的 `mods` 文件夹
3. 启动游戏，享受万物戴头上的乐趣！

English description
# Put Anything You Want On Your Head

**Have you ever wanted to wear a dirt block as a hat? Now you can!**

---

## 📖 What does this mod do?

This mod removes the vanilla equipment restriction for the **helmet slot only**.

With this mod installed, you can put **any item** in the game onto your head, including:

- 🧱 **Blocks** - dirt, stone, diamond blocks, stairs, etc.
- ⚔️ **Tools & Weapons** - swords, pickaxes, bows, etc.
- 🍎 **Food** - bread, steak, golden apples, etc.
- 🔴 **Redstone Components** - pistons, repeaters, comparators, etc.
- 🎨 **Any modded items**

The item will visually appear on your character's head, just like a normal helmet.

> **Important**: Vanilla armor slots (chestplate, leggings, boots) are **completely unaffected** and work exactly as they always have.

---

## 🎯 Why download?

- **Fun & Creative** - Create silly or stylish looks by wearing anything on your head
- **Role-playing** - Roleplay as a dirt-block monster or a walking diamond!
- **Lightweight** - Only one simple feature, no performance impact
- **Multiplayer Ready** - Works on both client and server (both need to install it)
- **Open Source** - MIT licensed, freely usable in modpacks

---

## ⚠️ Things you should know

### Compatibility
- **Minecraft Version**: 1.20.1
- **Mod Loader**: Forge 47.2.0 or higher

### Important Notes
- Items worn on the head **do not provide armor protection** unless the item itself has armor value (e.g., a diamond helmet still protects; dirt does not)
- Other armor slots (chest, legs, feet) **remain fully functional** - this mod only changes the helmet slot
- **Both client and server** need this mod installed for multiplayer

### Installation
1. Download the `.jar` file
2. Place it in your `.minecraft/mods` folder (client) or server's `mods` folder
3. Launch the game and enjoy putting anything on your head!
